recentItems.title: From firehouse to theater: An FDNY veteran’s emotional tribute to 9/11 heroes
recentItems.description:
A former FDNY firefighter is taking the stage in The Guys, Anne Nelson’s play inspired by the days following the Sept.11 attacks. The story follows a New York City fire captain struggling to write eulogies for eight fallen firefighters with the help of a journalist he has never met. The play stars Kevin Shea, a former FDNY firefighter who was the only member of his battalion to survive 9/11.  News 12 got a behind-the-scenes look at rehearsals ahead of performances at the North Fork Arts Center in Greenport.

recentItems.title: Huntington station spa employee arrested after forcible touching charge
recentItems.description:
A 39-year-old Syosset man, Steven Dunn, was arrested after Suffolk County police said he forcibly touched a woman during a massage treatment at Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa in Huntington Station on Dec. 19, 2025. Investigators said the woman reported the incident after Dunn allegedly contacted her on Facebook on Sept. 1 to say he had moved to a new workplace. Dunn was charged with forcible touching and is expected to be arraigned later in First District Court in Central Islip. Police are asking anyone who believes they may also be a victim to contact the Second Squad.

recentItems.title: Security camera catches masked thieves smashing jewelry cases with hammers
recentItems.description:
Security video captured masked intruders smashing display cases inside Bentley Diamond during an overnight burglary in Spring Lake Heights, New Jersey. The owner says a security alert woke him up, allowing him to watch the break-in unfold on his phone in real time. Police say they are pursuing numerous leads as the suspects remain at large. Store owners say no customers' personalized jewelry was stolen, and the business reopened after the burglary.

recentItems.title: Protest erupts outside City Hall over Mamdani’s 9/11 memorial appearance
recentItems.description:
Hundreds of demonstrators - including far-right influencer Jake Lang - gathered outside New York City Hall to protest Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s attendance at the annual 9/11 memorial ceremony at Ground Zero. The demonstration followed days of controversy and a petition that collected more than 100,000 signatures telling the mayor not to attend. Police confirmed at least one person was taken into custody as protesters and counter-protesters rallied outside City Hall.

recentItems.title: Connecticut News Today: ICE detention, cold case investigation and water rescue
recentItems.description:
A Southern Connecticut State University student identified as Deng Deng was detained by ICE at Tweed New Haven Airport over the holiday weekend, according to DHS. Meanwhile, investigators are renewing efforts to solve the 30-year-old murders of Stamford teenager Rhonda Johnson and her 6-month-old son Co'Ran, with advances in forensic testing and a $50,000 reward for information. The roundup also includes a Danbury slashing investigation, a suicide prevention vigil in Trumbull, and a water rescue off Stamford's Westcott Cove that saved a person and a dog from a sinking boat.

recentItems.title: The search dogs of 9/11: How veterinarians kept ground zero rescuers going
recentItems.description:
As search-and-rescue teams worked through the wreckage of Ground Zero after the September 11 attacks, rescue dogs faced dangerous conditions, injuries, and exhaustion. At the request of the NYPD, the Suffolk County SPCA brought a mobile veterinary hospital directly to the scene to care for the animals. Veterinarians ultimately treated roughly 350 search-and-rescue and therapy dogs, helping them continue their critical mission.
